name: ZX Spectrum
help: Click the screen to type. Shift is CAPS SHIFT; Control or Alt is SYMBOL SHIFT. Tapes load automatically; allow time for loading to finish.

name: Commodore 64
help: Click the screen to type. Escape is RUN/STOP; Alt is Commodore. After loading a PRG, type RUN or the program’s SYS command. Disk images require the 1541 ROM.

name: Commodore Amiga
model: A500 PAL + A501 · 1 MiB RAM and clock
help: Click the screen to capture the mouse. Escape releases it. Select an ADF before starting to boot from disk. AROS compatibility differs from Kickstart.

name: Nintendo Entertainment System
help: Arrow keys move; X is A, Z is B, Enter is Start and right Shift is Select. A cartridge is required.

name: Nintendo Game Boy
help: Arrow keys move; X is A, Z is B, Enter is Start and right Shift is Select. DMG cartridges only; this player starts after the boot-ROM sequence.
